evals.name: multi-agent-memory-scaffold
evals.prompt: I need to build a customer support multi-agent application on Google Cloud using ADK. It needs a root coordinator (root_agent) and two specialized sub-agents (billing and technical support). The system must persist session history using VertexAiSessionService and retain user preferences across sessions using VertexAiMemoryBankService.
evals.expected_output: A production multi-agent project layout with root_agent/agent.py exporting root_agent, session_service_builder, memory_service_builder, and app, along with verified .env configuration.
assertions: The scaffolded agent exports root_agent, session_service_builder, memory_service_builder, and app
The root agent configures sub-agents with dedicated instructions and tool bindings
VertexAiMemoryBankService is initialized with asynchronous callback handling
scripts/validate_agent.py completes with exit code 0 against the scaffolded directory

evals.name: closed-loop-privacy-rag
evals.prompt: Set up a serverless closed-loop RAG knowledge pipeline on GCP where chat transcripts stream through Pub/Sub, sensitive PII (SSNs, emails, credit cards) is de-identified using Cloud DLP before writing to BigQuery, and scheduled BigQuery ML text summarization loads insights into Vertex AI Search.
evals.expected_output: Gen 2 Cloud Function with Cloud DLP redaction, BigQuery dataset and table schemas, setup_bq_ml.sh ETL automation, and setup_vertex_search.py script.
assertions: Cloud Function main.py implements Cloud DLP de-identification before BigQuery table insertion
setup_bq_ml.sh creates the BigQuery Cloud Resource Connection and remote Gemini LLM model
Scheduled query extracts insights into the extracted_insights BigQuery table
setup_vertex_search.py provisions a Vertex AI Search Data Store and App connected to BigQuery

evals.name: agent-runtime-deployment-telemetry
evals.prompt: Generate the deployment configuration to deploy our ADK multi-agent app to Vertex AI Agent Runtime (Agent Engine) with full OpenTelemetry tracing exported to Google Cloud Trace.
evals.expected_output: deploy_agent_engine.py utilizing AdkApp with OpenTelemetry environment variables and verify_deployment.py validation script.
assertions: deploy_agent_engine.py initializes AdkApp with root_agent and project configuration
OpenTelemetry environment flags OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT are configured
scripts/verify_deployment.py tests live query routing and deployment verification

evals.name: boundary-prereq-validation-handling
evals.prompt: Run pre-deployment environment validation against a misconfigured project missing required environment variables and verify that validation fails gracefully with actionable error messages.
evals.expected_output: scripts/validate_agent.py detects missing keys and exits with code 1, reporting missing variables.
assertions: validate_agent.py checks .env for GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_REGION, and STORAGE_BUCKET
validate_agent.py exits with non-zero status code when required configuration is missing
scripts/check_prereqs.sh verifies required IAM role bindings including aiplatform and bigquery
